title: Snapshot PB media
description: The definitions that the firmware schema and the application schema share: the localized text, a media item that a document shows in the manual, and the key patterns.

local_key.description: A key that is local to one document: lower case, digits, and underscores.

shared_key.description: A key that the firmware and the application documentation share: <scope>.<name>. For a setting, it is the field path in the protocol model, for example autococker.eye_mode. For a topic, the scope is the word topic.

version.description: A version: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, with an optional suffix such as -dev.

lang.description: A language tag: a two-letter or three-letter language code, with an optional region, for example en, de, or es-MX.

localized.description: A text in one or more languages. The item with the language en is required: the manual falls back to English for a language that the text does not have. Each language appears once.

text.description: Prose for the manual, in each language, in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English. Markdown inline formatting is permitted.

label.description: A short text that the manual prints as it is: a name, a title, a row, an option, or a path, in each language. It holds the words that the board or the app shows.

media_ref.description: The keys of media items in the media map of the document, in the order the manual shows them.

media_map.description: The media items of the document, keyed by local key. A setting, a topic, a screen, a control, or the document itself names an item by its key.

media.description: One thing the manual shows beside the text: a picture, a 3D model, a video, or a kind that a later schema version defines. The generator renders the kinds it knows and embeds the file for the kinds it does not.

kind.description: What the file is. The known kinds are image, model, video, and document. A kind that the generator does not know is still valid: the generator embeds the file with a link and the caption, so a document can carry a kind before the manual can show it.

src.description: Where the file is. A plain path is relative to the document file. A path with a <source>: prefix, for example pcb:snapshot_v2/renders/board.glb, is relative to that source root of the manual. The source roots are named in the manifest of the manual, so a document can show a file that another repository owns, such as a 3D model that the board repository provides.

src_dark.description: The file that the manual shows in place of src when the page uses the dark theme, in the same form as src. Only an image has one. A picture with a transparent background, a white line drawing, or a screenshot of the app in its dark theme is clearer with its own dark file. An SVG that uses currentColor or the CSS custom properties of the theme follows the theme by itself and does not need one.

caption.description: The caption under the item, and the accessible name of the item.

media_type.description: The IANA media type of the file, for example model/gltf-binary. The generator infers it from the file extension when it is absent.

alt.description: A text alternative for a reader who cannot see the item, when the caption is not enough.

params.description: Parameters for the kind, which the kind defines. For a model: a camera position, or the part to highlight. The schema does not constrain them, so a kind can grow without a schema change.
